subject: Rescue Trampoline
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. COLOR ONLY edit of Image 1, the established modeling sketch sheet. Preserve its exact object design, proportions, silhouettes, all views, labels, page composition, white background and dark outlines. Image 2 supplies material COLOR inspiration, not geometry or lighting. Translate colors into neutral daylight, ignoring orange fire-light, smoke and cinematic shadows. This is a production reference for manually modeled LOW-POLY Blender assets: large flat color regions, restrained two-tone planar shading, matte simple materials, no photoreal texture, no microdetail, no new bevels or geometry, no glossy realism. Maintain the same colors across every view. Saturated medium blue padded octagonal rim with lighter pale-blue inner edging, dark charcoal navy fabric center, medium gray metal supporting frame and U-shaped legs with charcoal feet. Preserve stationary ground-supported design, not handheld people.
notes: Octagonal padded rim and taut center, adapted from the handheld Canvas reference to the stationary ground-supported trampoline in the GDD. Model frame, padding and fabric separately. Use four U-shaped supports arranged symmetrically under alternating sides; the drawn front and side support projections are approximate and must be reconciled in the 3D blockout.
geometry_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a grayscale 3D MODELING SKETCH SHEET for Fire Slop, matching its existing clean comic reference sheets. White background, confident dark ink contours, light gray planar shading, simple chunky low-poly-friendly construction, no dense texture. Landscape sheet. Large three-quarter hero and smaller clearly separated consistent orthographic views, all fully in frame. Minimal English title and view labels, no measurements or watermark. Reference image is inspiration only; draw a new isolated asset, not the screenshot, no background scenery or UI. Title 'Rescue Trampoline'. Use the broad padded octagonal rescue trampoline in the foreground of the attached reference as silhouette inspiration. Adapt it into a stationary ground-supported game prop: low wide regular OCTAGONAL outer frame, broad thick padded segmented rim, dark flat taut fabric center, simple tubular supporting frame beneath, FOUR stout U-shaped leg assemblies evenly spaced under alternating sides. No people holding it, no handles needed, no net, no poles, no ladder. Low enough to clearly read as a catching platform. Show large three-quarter hero plus TOP, FRONT and SIDE views, exactly same octagonal perimeter and four U-shaped supports consistently positioned. Broad geometry with few seams, keep spring hardware covered by rim padding. No burning house, flames, humans or scene. Show complete silhouette and readable underside construction.
